title: Linear Search
description: Write a Zig program that implements linear search to find the index of a target value (42) in an array.
hints: Zig supports iteration with index: `for (arr, 0..) |val, i|`
Use `?usize` for an optional/ nullable index type
Break out of the loop once the target is found
